items.title: Maps
items.summary: Flight route simulator between two points in Brazil, with the real path following the Earth's curvature and geographic data from the IBGE API.

images.alt: Map of Brazil with fields for entering start and end coordinates and a button to start the flight simulation
images.caption: Home screen

items.title: MNIST Classifier
items.summary: Application that recognizes handwritten digits drawn by the user, using a neural network trained on the MNIST dataset (Keras/TensorFlow).

images.alt: AI prediction result correctly showing the number seven after the drawing
images.caption: AI getting the prediction right

items.title: Irresistible Dating Proposal
items.summary: Fun dating proposal website where the "No" button runs away from the cursor whenever the user tries to click it.

images.alt: Dating proposal screen with the "No" button repositioned after a click attempt
images.caption: The "No" button always runs away

items.title: Expense Control
items.summary: Personal expense tracking application with full CRUD (create, list, edit and delete) using MongoDB.

images.alt: Expense list with one registered item, showing date, description, amount and edit and delete buttons
images.caption: Working CRUD: expense registered and listed

items.title: Unit Converter
items.summary: Unit converter for length, weight and temperature, with a simple interface and quick switching between source and target unit.

images.alt: Unit converter showing 10 kilometers converted to 10,000 meters
images.caption: Length conversion in action

items.title: Player Profile Clustering
items.summary: Machine Learning model (K-Means) that classifies soccer athletes into physical performance profiles from session metrics, served via API with ONNX.

images.alt: Scatter plot showing four athlete performance clusters visually separated with marked centroids
images.caption: Cluster visualization using PCA
